filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selections are all from highly-regarded channels with significant view counts, ensuring both quality and peer validation. The Arabic selections are strong, leveraging top academic channels like Dr. Ahmed Hagag. One topic, 'Combinatorial Proofs' in Arabic, had no eligible videos as all candidates focused on general or algebraic proof methods rather than the specific 'counting story' technique, leading to a coverage gap.
